residence.headline: A modern home, on a quiet street.
residence.body: Recovery doesn't happen in a facility. It happens in a kitchen, on a porch, in a single bedroom that feels like yours. Step by Step is a private residence in a residential St. Louis neighborhood — not an institution dressed up as one. Eight bedrooms, communal living, designed interiors, a kitchen that gets used.
bullets: Eight private bedrooms with hotel-quality linens
Communal kitchen, dining, and living spaces designed for use, not display
Outdoor space — a real porch, a real yard
Walking distance to coffee, transit, and the rhythms of normal life

lifestyle.headline: A home you'd recognize as one.
lifestyle.body: These rooms get used. Meals get cooked. Conversations happen on the porch. The space communicates: you are worth this.

method.headline: Five things we get right.
method.body: Recovery housing fails for predictable reasons — too many residents, too little structure, no follow-through, no design, no story for what comes next. Step by Step is built around five non-negotiables.

pillars.name: Small by design
pillars.body: Eight residents. Not twelve, not twenty. Every name is known. Every relapse risk is seen early.

pillars.name: Real structure
pillars.body: House meetings, recovery accountability, weekly one-on-ones, sponsor and step-work expectations — written down, followed through.

pillars.name: Dignified setting
pillars.body: A designed home, not a converted facility. The space communicates: you are worth this.

pillars.name: Present staff
pillars.body: Our team is in the house every day. Residents are known. Families have a same-day response standard.

pillars.name: A plan for after
pillars.body: We map the 6-month off-ramp from day one — work, education, sponsorship, housing, family. Discharge isn't a goodbye, it's a handoff.

why.headline: What "boutique" actually means here.
why.body: Boutique is overused in this industry. Here is what it means at Step by Step:

items.title: Eight residents, never more.
items.body: Capacity is a design choice, not a financial accident. We won't grow this house. We'll open another.

items.title: Present, not advertised.
items.body: Our team is here. Weekly one-on-ones. Family calls returned the same day. The brand isn't a holding company — it's the house, by name.

items.title: Designed for life, not for liability.
items.body: The home is furnished and finished as a residence, not as a facility. The communal kitchen has good knives. The porch has chairs that hold up to use.

items.title: A plan for after, from day one.
items.body: Recovery isn't a 90-day program. It's a 5-year arc. We map yours — work, school, sponsorship, family — from the first week.

items.title: Family is the second client.
items.body: We assume families are involved unless residents instruct otherwise. Communication is structured, weekly, and not gossip.

investment_teaser.headline: Building the next ten residences.
investment_teaser.body: Step by Step is the first of a planned residence portfolio. If you're an investor, family office, or strategic partner interested in private-pay recovery housing in the Midwest, we have a room for that conversation.

inquiry.headline: Reach out, on your terms.
inquiry.body: Whether you're considering Step by Step for yourself, for a family member, or as a referring professional, we'd like to hear from you. Inquiry is private. Nothing is shared until you choose.

footer_cta.headline: When you're ready, the door is open.

the_residence_page.meta_title: The Residence | Step by Step Recovery St. Louis
the_residence_page.meta_description: Walk through Step by Step's residence — eight bedrooms, communal living, designed interiors. The home is the program.
the_residence_page.intro: Eight bedrooms. One kitchen that gets used. A porch. A yard. A street with neighbors and trees. Recovery housing that is, at last, just a home.

sections.title: Exterior & neighborhood
sections.body: A residence in a real St. Louis neighborhood — tree-lined, walkable, on a real street. We chose the location for the same reason most families would: it feels normal, because it is.

sections.title: Communal interiors
sections.body: Kitchen, dining, living, and library are designed as one connected space — the place where most of recovery actually happens. Good light, good chairs, food made together.

sections.title: Private bedrooms
sections.body: Eight bedrooms, each with its own desk, blackout, and storage. Hotel-quality linens. Locking. Private. Yours.

sections.title: Outdoor space
sections.body: A porch with chairs that hold up to use. A yard for a long phone call. The everyday spaces that make a place feel like a home, not a facility.

the_method_page.intro: Recovery housing fails for predictable reasons. Step by Step is built around five non-negotiables — none of them flashy, all of them load-bearing.

about_page.meta_title: About | Step by Step Recovery St. Louis
about_page.meta_description: What Step by Step is, why we built it in St. Louis, and what the residence stands for.
about_page.intro: We built Step by Step because the city we love — St. Louis — has good treatment, hard-working nonprofits, and a real gap between detox and a sustainable life. The months after treatment are the months that make or break recovery, and the housing options for that window are largely either institutional, under-resourced, or both. We wanted to build the residence we wished existed.
about_page.values_intro: What we stand for, in plain language:

values.title: Recovery is a five-year arc, not a 90-day event.
values.body: Programs that end at 30, 60, or 90 days are missing the part that actually makes recovery stick. The residence is built around the months that come after primary treatment — when most relapses happen, and when most lives are quietly rebuilt.

values.title: Dignity is a design choice.
values.body: Hotel-quality linens, good chairs, a kitchen with real knives, a porch you'd want to sit on. The space communicates what we want every resident to hear: you are worth this.

values.title: Family is the second client.
values.body: Default communication is weekly check-ins for the first thirty days. Crises are escalated same-day. We don't surprise you a week later with something you should have known on Tuesday.

values.title: Boutique is a number, not a feeling.
values.body: Eight residents. Not twelve. Not twenty. The capacity is a design choice that protects outcomes — and it is not negotiable.

families_page.meta_title: For Families | Step by Step Recovery St. Louis
families_page.meta_description: What families can expect from Step by Step — communication, structure, dignity, and a plan for after.
families_page.intro: If you're reading this for someone you love, we assume two things: you've worked hard to get them here, and you're tired. Step by Step treats family as the second client. Here's what that looks like in practice.

partner_page.meta_title: Partner With Us — Investment Opportunity | Step by Step Recovery
partner_page.meta_description: A discrete page for investors, family offices, and strategic partners exploring private-pay recovery housing in the Midwest.
partner_page.intro: Step by Step is residence one of a planned portfolio. We're speaking with a small number of investors, family offices, and strategic partners who understand private-pay recovery housing as a category and the Midwest as an underserved market. If that's you, the conversation is private and on your terms.

thesis_blocks.title: The market gap
thesis_blocks.body: St. Louis has nonprofit and insurance-funded recovery housing. It does not have premium private-pay sober living that families with means actually choose. National references — Caron, Hazelden Betty Ford, Mountainside — operate at campus scale; the boutique-residence tier is largely empty in the Midwest.

thesis_blocks.title: The unit economics
thesis_blocks.body: An 8-resident residence at $7,500–$10,500/month, run with operational discipline, is a defensible single-asset business. The portfolio thesis multiplies it across St. Louis, Kansas City, Indianapolis, Louisville, and Memphis.

thesis_blocks.title: The team
thesis_blocks.body: Step by Step is operated by a leadership team with fifteen+ years inside this work. Detailed bios, governance structure, and operational protocols are available under NDA.

thesis_blocks.title: The structure
thesis_blocks.body: Single-purpose entity per residence. Detailed pro forma, use of funds, and milestones available under NDA. We are not raising on this page — we are inviting a conversation.
